title: Unit Event — Burn My Soul — Episode5 What You Need

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD and Ken burn the candle at both ends figuring out how they'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Tasked with reigniting fervor in the residents of Vivid Street, Akito tries to burn brighter than ever before, but will it go up in smoke?

rows.Line: A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Akito, you're still too tense!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (How many hours have we been practicing...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (My brain's not getting enough oxygen because of all this singing...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Let's stop here for today...
You're at your limit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay...
Got it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No... Again, why...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Even though Ken's working with me one-on-one, I can't produce any results...still...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (I've been trying every trick I know, but those shackles won't come off easily...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(I guess that's only natural...
After all, this is what brought Akito this far.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...
Hey, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Why don't we go for a drive?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now...?
One hour later
se_event_burn_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Let's make a pit stop here.
Want something to drink?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, sure...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Well, I accepted Ken's invitation, and now we're here...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, he actually just felt like going for a drive...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Or was he trying to give me a breath of fresh air because I was having trouble focusing?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, have a cafe au lait.
It's hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you.
se_event_burn_2023_001
se_event_burn_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (How long has it been since the last time I just sat and did nothing like this?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Lately, I've been practicing as soon as I wake up, then going to school, a live house after that and singing with Ken at the end... There's been no time in that schedule for me to relax...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to be doing this right now?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Wouldn't it be better for me to use this time to practice instead...?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: This reminds me of the first time I met you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Do you remember?
The first time we spoke to each other on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: What's wrong, kid?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? You're from RADder... What are you...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Here, drink this.
Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You remember how we met, Ken?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, like it happened yesterday.
The way you looked like you were about to start sobbing is hard to forget.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, you should definitely forget about that...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've changed so much since then.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You came this far by following your heart. I couldn't be more impressed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
So, tell me.
What was it like sprinting at full speed until now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What was it like...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So much has happened. I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Just like that.
se_event_burn_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ow...!
Wh-Why'd you flick my forehead...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So that you don't forget how you felt just now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Akito. Next time, sing with that feeling in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All you have to do now is realize that and sing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting late.
We should start heading back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.
Scramble Crossing
se_event_burn_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You're sure you don't want me to take you further than the station?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, since the trains are still running.
Thank you for working with me this late.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
No problem.
Just make sure to get some rest. See you later.
se_event_burn_2023_007

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All you have to do now is realize that and sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just need to realize it, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Based on what Ken said, it feels like the answer should be right in front of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm one step away from finding that thing I've been missing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Miku, you guys...
Shinonome, Aoyagi, An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am who I am now because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't have to worry about everything on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I should head over there.
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Were you guys practicing again today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we were.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, please take a seat.
I'm sure you're tired, so let me get you something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO told me everything!
You've all been going around to different live houses to perform at them, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That sounds like so much fun.
I'd love to see the live houses in your world.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, remember what I told you the other day? You shouldn't interrupt them needlessly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, what has training at these live houses involved? You must have been singing with some really good performers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we have...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're on a completely different level compared to us. We have to do everything we can just to keep up with them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have a planning meeting during the drive over after school, sing at the live house, do a debrief on our way home, then do it all over again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fortunately, we've somehow been managing to hold our ground...
...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: With that in mind, can I ask you guys something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, you've been practicing with An's dad...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
For a few weeks now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I'm having a lot of trouble making any progress...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand what Ken's telling me to do, but I can't figure out how to put that into practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, based on what you just told us, that does seem very tricky...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Relax and sing from your heart.
Turn your feelings into song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
In terms of actually accomplishing those things...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hmmm... That's a tough one.
This is all about intuition...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Akito.
Would you mind singing something for us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
I think hearing you actually sing will make it easier for us to give you proper advice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She has a point.
I think we'd all like to hear you sing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, then...
If you all don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A lot of time's passed since I last sang here because I've been practicing in our world so much...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But this is my chance to hear from Luka and the others about my singing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This might lead me to the answer...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Take your feelings...and turn them into song...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was incredible.
I think I've got goosebumps...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...! You sent shivers down my spine!
You've gotten so much better, Akito!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I have been practicing basically nonstop.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But tell me more.
What else did you guys notice?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sounded really amazing just now, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I feel like you can do a lot more! Like, pow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Pow...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know what you're trying to say, but you need to be more specific with your advice...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
But!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Akito, I'm guessing that you're feeling a lot of different things right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're happy about getting to practice with Ken. You're excited, and you want to make him proud, but you're nervous at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You should just let that all out. Pow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In other words, I'm not letting my feelings flow freely...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There's that...
But... How do I put it...? Oh.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Akito!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we do what you and Ken have been doing? Let's sing together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?
